prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: transparent PNG series cover for the warm wooden display shelf of 奇物百货.
Primary request: Create a NEW illustration for the vintage toy series “旧梦玩具”. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not the subject to retain. Match its delicate gouache and colored-pencil rendering, tactile paper grain, softly shaded collectible silhouette, warm cream highlights, restrained ochre and burgundy palette.
Subject: A charming sleepy pale-butter-yellow wind-up toy duck with tiny closed eyes, slightly bowed head, rounded wooden body, orange beak, small antique brass winding key clearly visible on its back; beside it a smaller cream wooden rocking horse with a muted mint-green saddle, tiny brass bell tied by a burgundy ribbon. These are two vintage toys, carefully arranged as one compact still life, not living animals.
Composition: square image, complete silhouettes, duck slightly left and forward, small rocking horse on right, group filling 80 percent of width and 78 percent of height with comfortable transparent margins. Eye-level slightly three-quarter view. Ground contact subtle, no display platform other than horse's curved wooden rockers.
Lighting: gentle warm light from upper left, amber shadow tones, clear readable shapes at small shelf size.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no wall, shelf, text, letters, logo, watermark, frame, frogs, plate or food. No photorealism, no vector/SVG style, no glossy 3D render. Raster hand-painted illustration.
